principal_correction: All main characters use the engine repertoire for internal AND external stimulus and interpretation flow; no exclusive character-engine ownership.
boundary: Engine output is itself something interpreted. Agreement is not proof; discrepancy remains meaningful. Character observations and actions below are authored fiction, not engine-returned observations.

character_flows.external_stimulus: Missing interval in the room, identified by Jian
character_flows.internal_stimulus: Urge to make the absence bearable through a beautiful explanation
character_flows.interpretation: Harmony-seeking may be shaping his account; lookup selected by Corv, not a diagnosis of the room
character_flows.chosen_action: Ask Sona what to hold and leave the slate alone
character_flows.feedback: Sona asks him to hold the question; absence remains unresolved
character_flows.revised_understanding: An unanswered signal can remain available without being converted into reassuring meaning
character_flows.reciprocal_action_refinement: Leaves disagreement available without requiring assent.

character_flows.external_stimulus: Membrane seam flexes under load and Sona chooses her position
character_flows.internal_stimulus: Tight jaw and urge to direct her stance
character_flows.interpretation: Root emphasis is a symbolic prompt to notice bracing; it cannot establish load-bearing safety
character_flows.chosen_action: Point out the edge, ask rather than command, plan cover around her position
character_flows.revised_understanding: The same observed motion can prompt closure or protection of a passage
character_flows.reciprocal_action_refinement: Waits for Sona to test the reach before fixing the span he would cover.

character_flows.external_stimulus: Sona objects that he is examining the wrong scale
character_flows.internal_stimulus: Irritation, shame, impulse to suppress the alert
character_flows.interpretation: A birthday-derived Low label could become an excuse; it does not evaluate her argument
character_flows.chosen_action: Restore the private mark and open a recurrence view
character_flows.feedback: Existing subsequent scene has Sona identify the cadence, Jian retune and acknowledge stable periodicity
character_flows.revised_understanding: The objection can be tested without deciding which person feels correctly
character_flows.reciprocal_action_refinement: Turns the scanner view toward Sona and asks where she would start.

character_flows.external_stimulus: Jian identifies declining variability and the host responds unevenly
character_flows.internal_stimulus: Relief misread as success, shaking hands after withdrawing the intervention
character_flows.interpretation: Her identity investment may be coloring the reading; the musical pattern organizes her attention but does not establish host recovery
character_flows.chosen_action: Keep contrary trace visible, mouth a familiar phrase, explicitly retain Jian as a corrective witness, reduce intervention
character_flows.feedback: Existing host response remains uneven; shaking does not magically disappear
character_flows.revised_understanding: Internal relief and external recovery are separate observations
character_flows.reciprocal_action_refinement: Moves her hand so Jian can mark the point she passed over.
